_why: Six device frames for the 'built for how bid teams actually work' rail: three phone, three tablet, alternating. These are purpose-shot captures rather than crops of the desktop library, so most are already clean. Only two need work, and both were found by sampling pixels rather than by looking: a success green outside the frozen palette on the bid/no-bid bars, and four destructive red buttons on the answer library.

items._src_note: Phone. Live Find a Tender notices: NHS Scotland generic and biosimilar cancer medicines, and a North Lanarkshire Council roads materials framework. Real values, real CPV context, nothing to clean.
Phone. The bid/no-bid fit panel, one of the surfaces that had never been captured before. Carries the honesty line the brand rules require: 'NOT a prediction of award'.
items._hue_why: Measured, not guessed: the fit bars are #1a8e52 and the posture pills #1c7358, both greens outside the frozen palette. An 18 degree rotation walks them into the teal end of our ramp. The teal button on the same screen (#0bb598) moves to cyan and the violets and pinks stay violet and pink, so nothing leaves the ramp.

items._src_note: Phone. The selection questionnaire, answered from the reusable answer set.
Tablet. The answer library with four genuine reusable answers: social value against the TOMs, mobilisation, carbon reduction, and open-book pricing.

items._src_note: Tablet. The social value scoring methodology, spelling out the deterministic proxy model and the five PPN 002 missions. The single most credible surface in the whole library and it needs nothing.
